referencePolicy: User references used for VFX shape/phases only; no ripped sprites extracted

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE clean professional PIXEL GAME SKILL VFX storyboard board for MINH KIEM, original metal swordsman class, six numbered rows MK01 to MK06 and exactly three columns labelled PREP, RELEASE, FADE. Flat charcoal background, spacious cells, each row a distinct skill, no portraits or UI hotbar. Use small original neutral-grey chibi mannequin and simple sword only for scale; effects are the main subject. Top-down action RPG perspective on ground XY, not side-scrolling martial-arts illustration. R1 MK01 PARRY: small angled silver hexagonal guard in front, one precise white-gold crescent counter on success, two short metal fragments fade. R2 MK02 DASH: pointed gold-white arrowhead at sword, thin straight thrust trail extending forward with actor visible, small dust at stop. R3 MK03 TRIPLE SLASH: three offset narrow arcs read one after another, final larger white-gold fan, staggered arcs break into short fragments; no full-screen swirl. R4 MK04 SHIELD: three small hexagon corner strokes, partial silver-gold shield rim around chest/HP region leaving actor visible, rim cracks and vanishes. R5 MK05 MOVEMENT ONLY: a thin blue-white line behind feet, a clean wind streak with NO impact explosion or hit spark, trail fades. R6 MK06 ULTIMATE LINE: five small gold ticks converge at sword point, ONE long narrow white-gold blade line framed by geometric metal fragments, line breaks into six short angular fragments. Palette ivory pale gold bronze silver blue shadows, metal geometric language. Sharp deliberate square clusters at 64-128px native effect scale enlarged nearest-neighbor, no gradients/bloom/blur/airbrush/3D, no red-orange fire, no random particle noise. Simple readable handcrafted pixel art easy for a beginner to redraw. Text only column headers and MK01..MK06. Reference images indicate three-phase VFX grammar only: do not trace or reuse any sprite, silhouette or watermark from references. This is a concept board, not a measured production atlas.

Create ONE ORIGINAL PIXEL GAME VFX CONCEPT board for ANH DAO fire/ember curved-saber class. Use reference ONLY for the six-row/three-column presentation layout and crisp pixel style, not its metal effects. Exactly six rows AD01..AD06, three columns PREP / RELEASE / FADE, flat charcoal background, generous gutters, small grey chibi mannequin with ONE curved dao for scale. Effects separate clean readable shapes, no soft glow. AD01 red-dark crescent edged orange cutting one target, fade into exactly3 short red status strokes WITHOUT gore. AD02 five-notch ember seed ring at one target, tiny compact ember burst on next strike, scatter into dull cinders; no automatic explosion on expiry. AD03 first diagonal orange slash then reverse low red slash, two distinct impacts, two broken trails fade; no targetable clone. AD04 thin vertical ember saber edge, three small ember chain marks around target feet, marks dim away; no huge chains covering body. AD05 MOVEMENT ONLY: low charcoal smoke ribbon and narrow orange edge showing actor, short curved foot trail fading, NO impact burst or phantom double. AD06 ULTIMATE: small ember flecks pull into blade, one low circular red-orange blade sweep with an OPEN center keeping actor visible, five short ember petals fade. Burnt umber/crimson/orange/pale-yellow tiny accents, flame triangular/ribbon language, not all skills generic fireballs. Handcrafted chunky sharp source pixel clusters,64-128px effect scale enlarged nearest-neighbor; max4 tones/material, restrained sparks, no gradients/bloom/blur/3D, no full-screen explosions. Text only AD01..06 and headers. Spatial shapes on top-down ground plane where appropriate; mannequins are pose hints only, not production animation sheet. Original design, no franchise emblems or copied reference sprites.

ONE original PIXEL GAME SKILL VFX storyboard board for HUYEN BUT water calligrapher class. Same layout as reference:6 numbered rows HB01..HB06,3 columns PREP / RELEASE / FADE, charcoal background and clear gutters. Use a small original grey chibi mannequin holding a LARGE CALLIGRAPHY BRUSH, never a sword; small ally mannequin where needed. Water as blue ink brush ribbons and droplets, not all generic glowing balls. R1HB01 draw a short horizontal ink stroke, launch ONE flat dark-blue/cyan brush-wave horizontally across ground, ribbon breaks into3ink droplets. R2HB02 three cyan dot marks near brush tip, ONE slender ice needle travels toward target and a small ice-petal forms at target feet, petals chip away. R3HB03 draw incomplete water ring at ALLY feet, a thin curved glass-blue shield rim at ally sides leaving face/body open, rim separates into two droplets. R4HB04 draw a dashed pale-cyan ground circle, sparse vertical rain drops INSIDE that ground circle with ally upright and visible, rain stops and a small ripple fades. R5HB05 backward movement: two tiny water strokes at feet, a narrow paired ribbon trailing forward as caster moves backward, thin water steps fade; NO attack projectile or impact burst. R6HB06 ultimate healing: a LARGE OPEN fictional geometric water seal under caster and allies, a low cyan ripple moves outward and small upright water bands briefly rise at ally feet, broken ring/6droplets fade. NO resurrection, no dragon summon, no green poison cloud, no ice spikes covering whole actor. Pale ivory/cyan/azure/deep ink limited palette,3-4steps per tone, square deliberate pixel clusters at64-128px effect source scale enlarged nearest. Top-down ground-plane rings, not tall wizard halos. Absolutely no smooth bloom/blur/gradients/3D/photo texture. Only labels HB01..06 and headers. This is visual reference not final atlas or combat logic.

ONE original PIXEL GAME SKILL VFX concept board for THACH CHUY earth/stone hammer guardian. Match reference ONLY6row x3column layout, small grey chibi mannequin scale, charcoal grid. Labels TC01..TC06 and PREP / RELEASE / FADE. Mannequin holds ONE compact stone-headed hammer, not sword. TC01 hammer raised with short ochre warning wedge in front; compact angular ground crack and stone-chip impact at target; cracks dissolve to dust, no persistent collision. TC02 thin ground ring around caster; LOW radial shockwave of chunky small square stone chips, center/actor stays visible; ring fragments fade. TC03 three small stone plates at shoulder/back/knee leaving face/arms visible; plates settle as defensive armor buff, then show small cracks and crumble; no giant enclosing golem shell. TC04 one hammer tap with three concentric ochre SOUND RIPPLES on ground; small threat-chevron marks pointing from ordinary enemy mannequins toward caster; ripples fade, no damage burst or forced boss movement. TC05 short shoulder-first dash with narrow low dust strip, one compact rock-ring impact at end, dust settles; actor remains visible, not teleport. TC06 ultimate sanctuary: open circle of low stone slab bases indicated on ground; several short stone slabs rise around a clearly OPEN sanctuary with entrance gap facing viewer and caster visible; slabs shrink to broken dust, NO impassable high wall, NO spike forest, NO volcano/lava, no ally-blocking cage. Warm ochre stone grey muted sand pale cream, square cracks/slab geometry NOT gold metal hexagons or orange fire. Simple sharp pixel clusters, max4tones/material, sparse dust, no glow/blur/gradients/3D. Top-down spatial ground cues. Beautiful readable original low-complexity game pixel art, not production atlas; figures are pose reference only.

ONE original PIXEL GAME SKILL VFX concept board for LINH CUNG wood/leaf bow archer, sixth-row three-column same clear charcoal layout as reference. Labels LC01..LC06 and PREP / RELEASE / FADE. LC01 a leaf-tip arrow nocks, one green-ivory arrow flies then a tiny branching TARGET MARK appears at enemy feet, mark breaks into three short leaf strokes. LC02 archer drops ONE seed at chosen ground point, a low green circular root trap grows with3small curled thorn branches, thorns recede into soil; NOT a giant tree cage. LC03 five tiny arrowhead glints near bow, FIVE distinct narrow arrows fanned slightly horizontally with individual leaf trails, separate compact impact leaf flecks; keep FIVE not a vague hundred arrows. LC04 five-to-seven pale-cream wooden flower slivers forming a100degree horizontal fan, low fan of leaf/wood splinters away from caster, separated petals drop; not an explosive green orb. LC05 archer slides BACK while aiming FORWARD, one backward leaf foot-streak plus ONE forward retaliatory arrow, trail and small arrow-impact flecks fade; do not show a clone or teleport. LC06 ultimate: large ground circle in moss green with small ochre border and THREE arrowhead motifs at center; FOUR staged groups of slender arrows rain vertically within circle, quiet leaf marks disappear. No ground spikes outside target circle, no tree summon or dragon/phoenix.
